title.narrative: Programa de Saneamiento Ambiental de la cuenca del Ro Reconquista
Reconquista River Basin Environmental Sanitation Program

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es recuperar la calidad ambiental de la Cuenca Del Ro Reconquista (CRR) a travs de la implementacin de un plan de gestin integral que priorice acciones impulsoras en ese sentido. Para motivar e incluir la poblacin en el proyecto, se priorizarn inversiones a poblaciones que viven en reas de riesgo sanitario, las cuales contribuirn a: (i) aumentar la cobertura de agua, alcantarillado y tratamiento de aguas residuales; (ii) mejorar la gestin integrada de los Residuos Slidos (RS) principalmente mediante el cierre de Basurales a Cielo Abierto (CBA); (iii) mejorar la conectividad y acceso a barrios perifricos asentados en reas de difcil acceso; y (iv) fortalecer la gestin operativa del Comit de Cuenca del Ro Reconquista (COMIREC) mediante el desarrollo de instrumentos de gestin que incluyen principalmente el Plan de Gestin Integral de la Cuenca del Ro Reconquista (PGICRR).

The objective of the program is to restore the environmental quality of the Reconquista River Basin (CRR) by implementing a comprehensive management plan that prioritizes leveraging actions in that regard. To motivate the population and include it in the program, priority will be given to investments aimed at those living in health risk areas. These investments will help to: (i) increase water, sewerage, and wastewater treatment coverage; (ii) enhance integrated solid waste management, primarily by closing open air dumps; (iii) improve connectivity and access to outlying neighborhoods located in hard-to-reach areas; and (iv) strengthen the operational management capacity of the Reconquista River Basin Committee (COMIREC) by developing management tools, which primarily include the Reconquista River Basin Comprehensive Management Plan (PGICRR).
